title: CBE Shadow Decision Record Schema
description: Formal JSON schema defining the machine-readable, immutable shadow decision record under CBE Sprint 11.15 Shadow Decision Protocol.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing 0-indexed sequence position in the append-only hash chain.

observation_timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the 5-minute bar close being evaluated.

data_availability_timestamp_utc.description: Point-in-time timestamp when market features became available. Must be >= observation_timestamp_utc.

source_identifier.description: Provenance identifier of the underlying market feed (e.g. binance_spot_btcusdt_5m_canonical).

btc_spot_reference_price.description: Last observable BTC/USDT spot reference price (USD per BTC).

hypothetical_usdt_balance.description: Hypothetical cash balance in USDT (non-negative, strictly enforced cash floor).

hypothetical_btc_balance.description: Hypothetical spot inventory in BTC (non-negative, long-only).

hypothetical_total_equity_usdt.description: Mark-to-market hypothetical portfolio equity (USDT + BTC * ReferencePrice).

market_regime.description: Classified macro/micro market regime at decision time.

uncertainty_score.description: Epistemic and aleatoric predictive uncertainty score.

evidence_rationale.description: Machine-readable dictionary documenting evaluated features, active filters, and gate outcomes.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the frozen research policy generating the decision.

policy_version.description: Frozen version tag of the policy specification.

code_commit_hash.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA corresponding to the engine executing this policy.

parent_decision_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the immediate predecessor decision record, forming an unbroken hash chain. Genesis is 64 zeros.

decision_hash.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash computed over the canonical, alphabetically sorted JSON serialization of all payload fields.
